observations: body L1-L9: the degrees, minutes and seconds of the values stand in columns, the figures of each column aligned on the right.

body L1, L8, L10, L12, L16, L18, L20, L26, L29, L32-L33: the dashes of the transliterated names, of the folios «30,r.–32,r.» and «176,v.–177,r.» and of «1423–1461» and «158–159» are long dashes (5.2 to 5.5 pt).
body L16, L30: specks stand above the full stop of «p.» before 158 and before the guillemet after «fuisse».
body L17-L18: in the head the dash after «c)» measures 10.0 pt and that of «29–37» 4.7 pt, a long dash; the dash after «I.» in L18 measures 10.4 pt.
body L19-L21: the arc of the sine 8p 4′ to the radius 60p is 7° 43′ 36″, nearer to the 7° 44′ of the tables than to 7° 43′. The minus sign of L20 is printed as a dash (9.4 pt).
body L22-L24: 82° 15′ 16″ and 82° 14′ 16″ are 82° 17′ and 82° 16′ less 1′ 44″, the precession of 54″ 33‴ a year in 1,9 years.
notes_left L4-L5: the year 199 of Yazdegerd begins on 28 April 830 and the year 215 of the hegira, counted from 15 July 622, on 27 February 830.

notes_right L4-L8: with al-Battānī's eccentricity 2p 4′ 45″, a change of 1′ in the mean anomaly changes the equation of the centre by 2″,0 at an anomaly of 0° or 360°; the change vanishes at 92° and 268°, where the equation is greatest, and is 0″,65 at 110° and 250°.
